It shows Katturupa in Sakkata, pākata]. Should desire.

ruci.p: [Ruca+i] (thī) CL=7 [Rucati dibbatīti ruci. Kaccaññaḥ.669. Rocete dippateti ruci. Dhāna,ṭī.64. Rocanaṃ ruci. Sī,ṭī,saca,2.388. Ruci-saṃ. Rui-prā, addhamāgadhī.] (1) Should fond. (A) Wisdom, Belief (or) Conviction (or) Opinion (or) View. (C) Desire. (2) Sāsanā which should be delighted. (3) Doctrine which should like ( wrong doctrine). (4) Good (or) Nice (or) Fine. (5) Color. (6) Be fond (or) Be pleased with. (7) Much enjoyment (or) Very take delight in. (8) Pure appearance (or) Fair appearance (or) White appearance. (9) Good looking. See original. Ruci(thī,pu) [ruca+i]  (1) (Queen) who is a wife of Ruci (who is future Buddha Koṇḍañña). (2) (Future Sucintita Thera). (3) (Future Buddha Vessabhū's ) Many-tiered called Ruci.
pn: Ruci 01. A king of the Mahā Sammata dynasty. He was the son of Aṅgīrasa and the father of Suruci. Mhv.ii.4; cf. Dpv.iii.7.
Ruci 02. A king of thirty-eight kappas ago; a previous birth of Sucintita Thera. Ap.i.134.
Ruci 03. A palace occupied by Vessabhū Buddha when he was yet a layman. Bv.xxii.19.
Ruci 04. One of the three palaces of Kakusandha Buddha before he left the world. Bv.xxiii.16.

P: Ruci，（f．） [fr．ruc，cp．Vedic ruc （f．） light，Classic Sk．ruci in meaning “pleasure”] 1．splendour，light，brightness Sn．548 （su° very splendid； SnA 453=sundara-sarīrappabha）．-- 2．inclination，liking，pleasure PvA．59 （°ṁ uppādeti to find pleasure，to be satisfied）．--aruci aversion，dislike Th．2，472．--ruci object of pleasure J．V，371．--ruciyā （Abl．） in the pleasure （of），by the liking （of） （cp．No．3），in phrases attano ruciyā （attano citta-ruciyā：so read for °ruciyaṁ!）； as one pleases，by one’s own free will，ad lib．J．I，106； IV，281； PvA．59； parassa r．pavattati to live by the pleasure （gratiâ） of somebody else，i．e．to be dependent on others DA．I，212．--yathā ruciṁ according to liking or satisfaction，fully，amply Mhvs 4，43； 5，230； PvA．88，126，242．‹-› 3．In dogmatic language used in the sense of “will” or “influence” in combn diṭṭhi， khanti， ruci one’s views，indulgence & pleasure （=will），i．e．one’s intellectual，emotional & volitional sphere，e．g．Vin．I，70； Sn．781 （without khanti，but see defn at Nd1 65）； also with saddhā，anussavo，ākāraparivitakke，diṭṭhinijjhānakhanti M．II，170，218； 234； contrasted with dhamma D．III，40； Vbh．245 （in defn of “idha”：cp．same at Ps．I，176 and Nd2 145），325，328．aññatra ruciyā under the influence of someone else’s will S．II，115； IV，138．See also bhāva 2a．（Page 572）

P: Rucira，（adj．） [fr．ruc，cp．Sk．rucira] brilliant，beautiful，pleasant，agreeable Pv．I，109 （=ramaṇīya dassanīya PvA．51）； J．I，207； V，299； Vv 402 （so read for rurira）； Mhvs 11，11； 18，68； Dāvs．IV，29； Miln．2，398； DhA．I，383 （=sobhana）； VvA．12； PvA．156 （=vaggu）．（Page 572）

rucaka.p: [Ruca+ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 [Ruca+ṇa. Ruca dittiyaṃ ṇvu. Dhāna,ṭī.577. Rucaka(ti)-saṃ.] (Na) (1) Gold block, gold lump, gold planks, gold plate, Gold coin. See - Ruca-(2). (2) It can be pleasure. (Pu) (3) Lemon (or) Cling (or) Err (or) Paramour, Rheukakrīḥ.(na).

[ရုဒ+ဿတိ။ ဒ-ကို စ-ပြု ဿ-ကို ဆ-ပြု။ ကစ္စည်း။ ၄၇၂၊၄၈၁။မောဂ်၊၆။၂၆၊၂၇။ နိရုတ္တိ။၆၄၆။ နီတိ၊သုတ္တ။၁ဝ၄၅။ ရုဒတိ-မှ။ ရောဒိပျတိ-သံ။ ရောစ္ဆဣ-ပြာ။]

a: ရုစိတ-သံ။ ရုဣအ-ပြာ၊ အဒ္ဓမာဂဓီ။] (၁)နှစ်သက်အပ်သော။(၂)နှစ်သက်အပ်ရာ။(န)(၃)နှစ်သက်ခြင်း။(န)ရုစိတကာလ-ကြည့်။
